notes: The closing 'it' of 'have spoken it' is added, no object morpheme standing in the Hebrew (rules 44, 30).
תֹכְחוֹת חֵמָה is rendered attributively as 'wrathful rebukes', so rule 28 rather than rule 19 governs it.
The temporal בְּ + infinitive divides by rule 52, the suffix taking the subject 'I' (rule 18).
